column1: # These are OUTLAYS only (direct/elective payments and refundable portions recorded as spending). The larger revenue-side cost of the credits (credits claimed against tax or transferred under sec. 6418) is NOT in this file.

# Account 020-0963 title is truncated in CBO's file; it appears to be the sec. 6417 elective-payment account for energy credits generally (its Jan 2025 level of ~$15.7B in FY2025 is consistent with CBO's 61188 report: ~$13B 45X/48C outlays + ~$1B ITC/PTC outlays in FY2025) - compiler inference
# 020-0962 is the 48D CHIPS credit elective payment (not IRA clean energy). 020-0931 contents are not documented in the file and may not be energy-related; included only for completeness.

# CBO (Outlook ch. 5): technical revisions cut projected energy-credit outlays by ~$0.1 trillion over 2026-2035 because CBO now expects a larger share of the remaining credits to be claimed as tax credits (revenue) rather than direct payments - so the drop vs Jan 2025 is mostly reclassification
